reason: The present-perfect ownership duration successfully expresses the continuing-state span represented by marriage and ownership evidence. Using for years instead of a since starting point changes how duration is specified, not the core past-to-present state-marking ability.
pattern_label: Expressing states continuing from the past
pattern_description: Difficulty examples use simple present for states explicitly continuing from earlier, while positive spontaneous examples use appropriate past-to-present duration forms. This supports the same continuing-state ability across starting-point and elapsed-duration expressions.
